published_by: Ofgem, 'Debt and arrears indicators' (the chart data behind the page, served as Everviz embeds)
what_this_is: THE PUBLISHED COUNT, NOT A READING OF IT. GB domestic ELECTRICITY accounts, at one quarter-end per year, in two separate Ofgem series: accounts in arrears with no arrangement to repay, and accounts with a consumer repaying an energy debt. Kept as the two published columns; their sum ('indebted accounts') is a reading, made by the reader and re-made independently by the year-keyed rate census. The counts are ACCOUNTS PER FUEL, not households: a dual-fuel household indebted on both fuels is one electricity account here. Gas is published beside it and not carried, because nothing reads it yet.

basis.units: domestic electricity accounts, GB, at the quarter-end named
basis.year_key: the year whose quarter-end is named in `quarter`: Q4 for every closed year; the open year carries the latest quarter published (Q2 2026 at this edition), not a Q4

series.in_arrears_no_plan: Everviz chart gvS7WsWVw, 'Number of accounts in arrears where there is no arrangement to repay the debt', column Electricity
series.repaying_on_plan: Everviz chart QG6XVhNPt, 'Number of accounts with a consumer repaying an energy debt', column Electricity

source_check.how_to_recheck: The Everviz embeds carry no edition marker and are overwritten in place each quarter: GET https://app.everviz.com/inject/gvS7WsWVw/ and https://app.everviz.com/inject/QG6XVhNPt/, extract the inline `csv`, and compare the Electricity column at each year's Q4 (and the latest quarter) with `accounts`. A new latest quarter is expected; a moved closed-year Q4 is a supersession. If the chart ids stop resolving, the ids are in the debt and arrears page HTML as `highcharts-<id>`.
